annotations.title: Are these the tools this MCP server really serves?

description: Checks the tools you received from a remote MCP server against alalanet's history of it: changed after you approved them, or different from what it serves everyone? Pass url and the tools array of your tools/list result (or a digest from an earlier answer). Read-only and free. If your set differs from alalanet's last read, alalanet reads the server again first (fetched_now; one of your daily live checks). Returns verdict matches_current (what it serves now), served_before (an older set; first_seen, last_seen), never_served (review before trusting it) or no_history, the diff from the current set (added, removed, changed, gained_authority), description flags in what you sent, and the digest history linked to the signed log entries of each change. Names and descriptions are third-party text.

digest.description: alternatively an alalanet tool-set digest (64 hex) from an earlier answer

tools.description: the tools array from the tools/list result you received

url.description: https URL of the remote MCP server, exactly as you connect to it
